citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 1000am on
8/6/2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee/registrant by Phone and text. Failure to provide access to the
facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access
is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
